blockers: budget approval for Dedicated GPU pool
notes: Initial scope: replace brittle keyword search -> RAG for ticket deflection + agent assist. Primary goal: reduce live-agent load by 30% while keeping top-5 answer precision high.
Indexing scale: customer expects ~18-25M support artifacts (KB articles, past tickets, macros). Looking for vector index that can handle 20M+ vectors with daily 200k delta ingestion.
Latency SLOs: interactive support chat workflow requires 95th pct end-to-end latency <200ms, 99th pct <400ms for 'suggested responses'. Reranker step must not push 95th pct over 350ms.
Cost sensitivity: target cost per user query (embeddings + ANN + rerank) < $0.005 avg; CFO flagged ceiling at $0.01. Wants model/batching recommendations to hit <$0.004 if possible.

Model preferences: embeddings: 768-d float32/quantized options ok. Preference for open models from Redwood catalog (cost + control). Reranker: cross-encoder for top-5 quality; willing to run on dedicated GPU pool.

Routing/fallback needs: strict region routing (EU data residency for EU customers), fallback to smaller quantized model when dedicated capacity saturated. Must support canary rollouts for reranker config.
Security/Compliance: SSO via SAML, audit logs to SIEM, KMS-managed keys, 7-year retention policy for legal hold. Must provide proof of SOC2 or comparable controls.

POC ask: ingest 10M doc sample, run end-to-end with Redwood Dedicated + local reranker on GPU. Measure throughput (QPS target 120 qps sustained) and 95th pct latency. Provide cost projection for 1M monthly queries.
Quote from CTO (paraphrase): 'We can tolerate slightly lower recall if top-5 are always correct — reranker quality is the gating factor.'
Internal notes: SE emphasized use of prefix caching for chat to reduce token cost; also recommended per-customer routing keys and aggressive shards for index locality.
Data pipeline: nightly full reindex + streaming upserts during day. Requires idempotent upsert API and TTL policies for ephemeral session docs.
Technical constraints: cannot export raw vectors outside VPC for EU customers. On-prem option for lowest latency sites but prefer Dedicated in first phase.

Decision criteria: 1) Meet latency SLOs under 100k qps? (no, expected initial QPS 120) — more important: 95th/99th percentile within stated bounds; 2) Clear cost model; 3) Security sign-offs; 4) Easy ops (rollouts, tracing).

Competitive notes: evaluating Pinecone + OpenAI (cheap embedding inference but costly rerank), Milvus self-hosted (ops burden), Redwood wins on integrated routing + cost controls if Dedicated performance numbers look good.

Sales ask: prepare two proposals — Dedicated pool sizing (N GPUs, with expected latency numbers) and Private/VPC option for EU-only residency. Include Optimize suggestions (quantization + batching) and likely ARR impact.
Churn risk: high if reranker can't reach top-5 precision target. Budget timing pinned to fiscal Q2 review (Apr 2026).
Acceptance criteria for POC: ingest sample, demonstrate <200ms median and <350ms 95th for full pipeline, show reranker increases top-5 precision by >=8 percentage points vs dense-only baseline.
Misc: requested a short one-pager comparing Dedicated vs Private for cost/latency/residency. Asked for rough Jira ticket for security team to track SOC2 docs (linked_support_tickets above).
Next demo scheduled: reranker microbench + live QPS run — scheduled after security sign-off.
